# Events

Standardized events describe what an application observed and how it progressed.
Calling an event method emits a record; it does not perform the operation or
change application state. Definitions come from `catalog/ApplicationEvents/events.json`.

## Categories

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [Application](Category_Application.md) · [API](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ApplicationEvents) | Events that are related to the lifetime of the application, like starting, pausing, stopped\. A typical app&#39;s lifecycle will be: Starting \-&gt; Started \[\-&gt; Pausing \-&gt; Paused \[\-&gt; Resuming \-&gt; Resumed\]\] \-&gt; Stopping \-&gt; Stopped\. |
| [Configuration](Category_Configuration.md) · [API](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ConfigurationEvents) | Reports configuration loading attempts, validation attempts, and individual setting results\. Successful loading does not imply validation, and successful validation does not imply that a candidate has been applied\. |
| [Dependency](Category_Dependency.md) · [API](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.DependencyEvents) | Reports failures to locate, load, or construct application components\. Resolution outcomes do not automatically determine application mode\. |
| [Diagnostics](Category_Diagnostics.md) · [API](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.DiagnosticsEvents) | Explicit diagnostic events, including the traditional teapot novelty event\. |
| [External](Category_External.md) · [API](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ExternalEvents) | Reports operations involving external dependencies\. Operation outcomes do not automatically determine the application&#39;s operating mode\. |

## Usage and operational guidance

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents` and access a category through an
existing `ILogger`, for example `logger.Application.Starting()`.
Category access preserves the logger's original logging category, providers,
and configuration. Detailed pages show signatures and caller-supplied arguments.

- [Configuration loading and validation](../architecture/CONFIGURATION-VALIDATION.md)
- [External operations](../architecture/EXTERNAL-OPERATIONS.md)
